newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly weak, fuel edges higher.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly weak, fuel edges higher.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly steady on Friday, traders said.
Gasoline was weaker in line with sagging futures prices. A Eurograde cargo was heard sold transatlantic but this was in spite of a closed arbitrage window to the U.S.
Naphtha was weaker as crude oil futures fell, and because of increasing supply.
Gas oil eased in line with benchmark IPE futures. Heating oil barges traded at July IPE -75 cents fob ARA.
High sulphur fuel oil barges closed a little firmer, trading at $82.50 fob ARA in the late afternoon after earlier deals at $81, $79.50 and $79.
High sulphur cargoes seemed steady with a Russian cracked cargo reported to have fetched about flat to the two means of published quotes.
